business_summary: Mainichi Comnet Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate business in Japan. The company offers real estate consulting services. It is also involved in the rental of apartments for students; developing and selling developed condominium buildings to listed REITs, real estate funds, individuals, and companies; management and operation of student apartments and university dormitories; development of student dormitories; private finance initiative management; and mixed development of rental housing and commercial facilities. In addition, the company provides revitalization plans for existing real estate, such as company dormitories; architectural design; and a building leasing system. Further, it offers student life solutions comprising outsourcing of student services; housing field activities; planning and arranging club activities, club and circle training camps, seminars, and training camps and training trips; planning and management of sports events; driver's license acquisition support services; extracurricular activities, including clubs, seminars, and circles; and seminar house consulting services to real estate brokerage and real estate utilization. Additionally, the company provides Campus Career, a program developed to connect students with society; and new graduate recruitment solutions. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
